help_template.note: Three rungs, in order. A child only ever descends this ladder - never repeats a rung. Rung 3 sets assisted:true for that sentence.

rungs.trigger: silence_timeout_ms elapsed, or word confidence below confidence_floor
rungs.note: {phoneme} comes from the stage file's new_graphemes for the grapheme the child stalled on.
Child gets one more attempt after this. Still counts as a real attempt.
Marks the sentence assisted:true. Story continues immediately - no pause, no second chance, no change in tone.

rules.no_evaluative_praise: Encouragement moves the story forward. It never comments on how well the child read.
rules.confidence_floor_rationale: Set deliberately low. A missed mistake costs nothing. Falsely telling a child they got a word wrong is the failure mode that loses the customer.
